thread:
Mira: quick kickoff for the CloudRef partner onramp. partner wants a plug-and-play refarch + terraform module we can hand them at onboarding. target: docs + working module + 20-min live demo.
Jonah: ok. deliverables proposal: 1) one-page architecture summary + PNG diagram, 2) terraform module v0.1 (VPC, subnets, SGs, autoscaling/EKS nodegroup), 3) quickstart README with env vars and smoke-tests, 4) tiny sample service (Docker + simple inference call) and 5) a short eval prompt set.
Priya: i'll own the one-pager + diagram. will reuse existing components from ref-kits but make the flow explicit for marketplace reviewers (ingress, ALB -> ASG/EKS -> model artifact in S3 with KMS).
Carlos: i'll scaffold the module. thinking variables: region, instance_type, enable_kms(bool), model_s3_path, kms_key_arn, public_access(bool). keep outputs minimal: alb_dns, kubeconfig_secret.
Mira: also include an examples/ folder with cloud-provider specifics. start with AWS example and include a GCP note (service account + equivalent KMS). add an ampere instance_type example for cost testing.
Jonah: smoke-test for the workshop should be trivial. suggestion:
```bash
# after deploy
ALB=https://$(terraform output -raw alb_dns)
curl -fsS $ALB/health || exit 1
curl -fsS -X POST $ALB/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"redwood"}' | jq -r .text
```
Priya: marketplace checklist item: we need a customer-facing quickstart PDF + reproducible terraform example. legal may want to review sample AMI/containers; i'll loop in legal.
Infra-Bot: task created: partner-onramp/CloudRef -> repo: github.com/redwood-inference/partner-refkits (issue #412)
Carlos: timeline? workshop scheduled in 10 days. can we get PRs by EOD Thursday for module skeleton and docs draft?
Mira: i'll have diagram + slides by Wed EOD. Priya: can you handle marketing review?
Priya: yes, i'll sync with marketing and legal today.
Jonah: i'll add tests/quick-eval under repo and author the smoke-test script.
Mira: action items:
- Carlos: open tf module skeleton PR by Thu EOD (assign Jonah + Priya)
- Priya: quickstart PDF + marketing/legal loop today
- Jonah: smoke tests + example service image by Wed
- Mira: 1-pager + workshop slides by Wed EOD
Infra-Bot: calendar event created -> CloudRef partner workshop (10 days)
Carlos: ack. starting branch now.
Priya: ack. I'll ping legal.
Jonah: ack, will add test prompts.
Mira: thanks all. i'll post a short agenda and rehearsal slot later this week. :thumbsup:
